items.name: b12441
items.body:
<details open>

webgpu: support per-head flash attention masks (#32394)

The flash attention shaders indexed the mask without its head
dimension, so masks with ne[2] > 1 gave wrong results. The mask offset
and the vec block states now include the head, broadcast as
head % mask->ne[2] like the other backends. The params buffer grows to
256 bytes to fit the two new mask fields.

The shared memory estimate dropped kv_shmem when only one of K and V
is read directly, while the shaders keep it unless both are, which made
the K f16 / V q8_0 cases exceed the workgroup storage limit. The vec kv
tile now takes both flags: the memory estimate drops kv_shmem only when
both are direct, and the tile still divides the KV padding when either
is. get_alloc_size and supports_op use the same rule as the pipelines,
and supports_op accounts for the register tile fallback.

</details>
